desc:
Steal eggs from giant bosses, run home, and HIDE before they catch you!

🥚 Steal eggs from the Goose, Snake, Monkey, Bear, Mole, Bees, T-Rex and Dragon
🐣 Hatch rare pets and fuse them into stronger ones
💰 Your pets earn coins, even while you're away
🏃 Train your speed to outrun faster bosses
🌿 Hide in bushes, pots and more when they get close
🎁 Free daily rewards and a daily spin
👥 Play with friends for a Friend Boost!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for more updates!
